title.zh: 芯片制造里的可靠性有哪些参数？
title.en: Which reliability parameters matter in chip manufacturing?

subtitle.zh: 从器件、互连到封装，带你看懂常见可靠性指标
subtitle.en: Common reliability metrics for devices, interconnects and packages

body.zh: 栅氧在电场作用下发生击穿
body.en: Gate oxide breaks down under an electric field

body.zh: 金属互连中原子迁移导致失效
body.en: Atomic migration in metal interconnects causes failure

body.zh: 测试：大电流密度＋高温应力
body.en: Test: high current density + high-temperature stress

body.zh: 静电放电造成器件瞬时损伤
body.en: Electrostatic discharge causes instantaneous device damage

body.zh: 偏压与温度导致阈值电压漂移
body.en: Bias and temperature shift threshold voltage

body.zh: 电源分布不均导致电压下降
body.en: Uneven power distribution causes voltage drop

body.zh: 评估：版图＋仿真/ 测量
寄生PNPN结构被触发导致大电流
body.en: Triggered parasitic PNPN structure produces high current

body.zh: 热载流子注入栅氧导致退化
body.en: Hot carriers injected into gate oxide cause degradation

body.zh: 测试：高场 ＋ 高温偏压应力
body.en: Test: high field + high-temperature bias stress

body.zh: 热胀冷缩导致封装/焊点疲劳
body.en: Thermal expansion and contraction fatigue packages / solder joints

body.zh: 指标：循环次数/裂纹 /失效
吸湿导致回流时“爆米花”现象
body.en: Absorbed moisture causes popcorn cracking during reflow

body.zh: 指标：吸湿量/ 爆米花等级
可靠的芯片 = 可用、耐用、值得信赖！
body.en: Reliable chips = usable, durable and trustworthy!
